needed.suggestion: Install a wider sidewalk to provide a safer pedestrian path.
Remove obstructions from the sidewalk to ensure it is fully usable.
Repair uneven sections of the sidewalk to prevent trip hazards.
Install a marked pedestrian crossing to improve safety.
Ensure the crossing area is clearly marked and visible to enhance pedestrian safety.
